description: `env/jsdom-shared-timer-flag` with the package's timer set from the callback of the test's own timer. The package's module-level flag (`running`, until the queued work runs) is cleared only by its own timer's callback, 100 ms after `schedule`, on jest-environment-jsdom with one worker. `leaves-work` is the larger file, so it runs first: its test sets a timer whose callback queues work, waits for that callback, and ends while the package's timer is still pending. `runs-work` queues work and waits for it. Jest passes both: each file evaluates the package again, so the second file's copy has its own flag.
